project_type: Greenfield hackathon prototype: two ESP-IDF firmware projects (ESP-NOW CSI transmitter + CSI receiver derived from espressif/esp-csi get-started examples) plus a local Python backend (serial ingest, CSI parsing, signal processing, heuristic fall detection), a Streamlit dark-mode dashboard, a synthetic simulation mode, and optional scikit-learn Random Forest training.

Kill the server afterwards. 6) Firmware cannot be compiled here because ESP-IDF is not installed; do not claim firmware build verification. Validate C sources only by careful review against the reference examples in /tmp/esp-csi.

User requirements: no fabricated readings in live hardware mode; simulated data must be clearly labelled synthetic everywhere (UI banner, recorded metadata, synthetic=true flag) and never used as accuracy evidence; never imply medical validation (persistent disclaimer in UI and README); do not claim classifier accuracy without held-out real-session evaluation; two ESP32s only, no router, no mesh; offline operation; do not invent unsupported ESP-IDF APIs.
key_patterns: Firmware: copy and minimally adapt /tmp/esp-csi/examples/get-started/csi_send and csi_recv (ESP-NOW broadcast from fixed MAC 1a:00:00:00:00:00 on channel 11, HT40 below, MCS0 LGI, receiver in STA + promiscuous, esp_wifi_set_csi_config/esp_wifi_set_csi_rx_cb/esp_wifi_set_csi, filter by sender MAC, packet id read from info->payload + 15, esp_csi_gain_ctrl component >=0.1.4 for S3/C3/C5/C6). Serial format is the official CSV line: classic ESP32/S3/C3 header 'type,id,mac,rssi,rate,sig_mode,mcs,bandwidth,smoothing,not_sounding,aggregation,stbc,fec_coding,sgi,noise_floor,ampdu_cnt,channel,secondary_channel,local_timestamp,ant,sig_len,rx_state,len,first_word,data' (25 fields) and C5/C6 header 'type,seq,mac,rssi,rate,noise_floor,fft_gain,agc_gain,channel,local_timestamp,sig_len,rx_state,len,first_word,data' (15 fields); data is a quoted JSON-style int array, interleaved [imag, real] per subcarrier (official parser: complex(raw[2i+1], raw[2i])). Classic chips: first 128 values (64 subcarriers) are LLTF in order subcarrier 0..31 then -32..-1; HT-LTF / STBC-HT-LTF follow for HT packets. Legacy 20 MHz valid LLTF subcarriers are indices 1..26 and 38..63 (52 subcarriers); index 0 is DC; first_word_invalid=1 means the first 4 bytes (subcarriers 0 and 1) are invalid. Python: plain packages backend/, dashboard/, simulation/ at repo root, dataclasses + JSON config (no pydantic), numpy/scipy for DSP, pandas for CSV, plotly for charts, streamlit with st.cache_resource-held background engine thread and st.fragment(run_every=...) polling. Every data source (serial, replay, simulation) yields raw text lines that go through the same parser and pipeline.
